editorial.blurb: AMBAR brings Balkan cuisine to Chicago with an impressive array of small-plate dishes that let you taste your way through the menu, backed by thoughtful service and a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Unlimited Ambar Experience (available at brunch and dinner) to sample 2+ dozen dishes in perfect portion sizes—reviewers rave that it's the best way to experience the full menu without overcommitting.

topDishes.note: Reviewers call it the best they've had since moving to the U.S.
Tender and a non-negotiable must-try according to fans
